qa_pairs.instruction: What knowledge and expertise are required for installing the Linux and UNIX Settings driver?
qa_pairs.output: Successful installation of the Linux and UNIX Settings driver requires knowledge and expertise with Identity Manager and iManager. If you will be using LUM or NetIQ Samba, you also need knowledge and expertise with OES.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the required knowledge and skills for the Linux and UNIX Settings driver installation.
